• Announced FDA accepted a supplemental New Drug Application (“NDA”) submission for Yeztugo 300-mg tablet as a potential once-weekly oral formulation for HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis, with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (“PDUFA”) target action date of February 2, 2027.

The decision was based on the recommendation of the external Data Monitoring Committee, following review of data from a pre-specified final analysis of progression-free survival and interim analysis of overall survival. 28 • Completed the acquisition of Tubulis GmbH (“Tubulis”), which brings Gilead next-generation antibody-drug conjugate (“ADC”) assets, including TUB-040, a NaPi2b-directed topoisomerase-I inhibitor ADC, and a platform to develop novel ADCs.
• Announced that the Biologics License Application for anito-cel in 4L+ R/R MM has been accepted by FDA, with a PDUFA target action date of December 23, 2026.
